gc_triggering_operation.description: operation that may allocate/rehash and trigger an emergency GC while using a GC-managed object

root_anchor.description: anchors a GC-managed object in a strong root (e.g., on the Lua stack) so it cannot be collected during a GC-triggering operation

weakly_referenced_object.description: type of GC-managed object that can be reachable only through a weak container and may be collected during an emergency GC
